title: hermeneutic: local correction evidence, retrieval, and deterministic English drift checks
description: Hermeneutic preserves correction episodes and explicit user/host interpretations as scoped, attributed lessons. Later tasks can retrieve bounded candidate context; the host checks applicability before acting. Default lesson retrieval is local and lexical, with inspection and revocation. Interpretation is supplied explicitly, not generated by a hidden model. A separate deterministic English draft gate checks surface claims; experimental language mappings are advisory. Optional embedding retrieval and caller-configured Router stages remain separate. Private correction data is not distributed, and broad downstream effectiveness remains unmeasured.
